summary_en: DreamArts increased its FY2026 year-end dividend forecast to 30.00 yen per share from 20.00 yen, adding a commemorative 10.00 yen special dividend to mark the company's 30th anniversary in December 2026.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Dividend Forecast for FY2026 (30th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, DreamArts' Board of Directors approved a revision to the dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending December 2026. The year-end dividend per share has been increased to 30.00 yen from the previously announced 20.00 yen. This increase includes a special commemorative dividend of 10.00 yen marking the company's 30th anniversary, combined with the ordinary dividend of 20.00 yen.

The company was founded in December 1996 and will reach its 30th anniversary in December 2026. The special anniversary dividend is intended to express gratitude to shareholders for their long-standing support. The company clarified that this commemorative dividend is a one-time measure and will not be included in the baseline for the company's progressive dividend policy, which targets a payout ratio of around 30% and aims to maintain or increase dividends from the prior year. The ordinary dividend of 20.00 yen per share will remain the basis for future dividend progression.

The prior year (FY2025) year-end dividend was 20.00 yen per share. The final Board resolution is scheduled for February 2027.
